extractionNotes: EXTRACTION COMPLETE: all 4 Strands x 3 Years (12 Strand/Year objects) fully captured. Totals reconcile exactly against the Scope and Sequence summary table's SHS1-3 overall figures: 36 Content Standards, 37 Learning Outcomes, 85 Learning Indicators (verified by direct count of the extracted tree, not just the printed table). 30 of the 85 Learning Indicators are flagged NEEDS_REVIEW, the large majority (24) purely for the confirmed code-collision pattern (codeCollisionWith/codeDuplicationNote), the remainder for genuine printed data-quality anomalies (wrong Year/Sub-Strand code prefixes, non-standard Assessment text replacing the DoK boilerplate, an apparent 'issue culture'/'tissue culture' typo repeated in two Years, a dropped verb, and one Learning Outcome with no printed Content Standard). See the per-node reviewNote/codeNote/codeDuplicationNote fields for the specific reason in every case.

Structure confirmed by reading the full body (PDF pages 23-98, printed footer pages 21-96): 4 Strands (New Dawn in Agriculture / Farming for Jobs and Income(s) / Mobilisation of Resources and Networks / Agriculture and Climate), each Strand's name and its Sub-Strand set recur across all three Years but are NOT always identical in wording or sub-strand count per Year - see individual strands[].namePrintedVariants and subStrands[].namePrintedVariants below for confirmed spelling drift (e.g. 'NEW DAWN IN AGRICULTURE' Year 1 vs 'NEW DAWN AGRICULTURE' Years 2-3; 'FARMING FOR JOBS AND INCOME' Year 1 vs 'FARMING FOR JOBS AND INCOMES' Years 2-3).

CONFIRMED (per prior sample and re-confirmed against the full body): Learning Indicator and Assessment code numbering restarts at .1 for EACH Content Standard within a Sub-Strand, not continuing sequentially across the whole Sub-Strand - i.e. a Sub-Strand with two Content Standards (CS.1, CS.2) has TWO separate 'LI.1'/'AS.1' pairs, one per Content Standard. This is confirmed WIDESPREAD across the whole document, not an isolated occurrence in the sampled Sub-Strand - it recurs in effectively every multi-Content-Standard Sub-Strand checked in Years 1, 2 and 3. Every such collision is flagged individually on the affected node via codeDuplicationNote/codeCollisionWith, per the established sample convention.

Strand 3 'Mobilisation of Resources and Networks' Sub-Strand 1 'Land Tenure Systems for Agriculture' is taught ONLY in Year One - confirmed absent (no heading, no codes) from the Year Two and Year Three bodies of Strand 3, which contain only Sub-Strand 2 'Support Systems in Agriculture'. This is a genuine structural asymmetry (not every Sub-Strand recurs in every Year), preserved as found; flagged NEEDS_REVIEW at the Strand 3 Year 2/3 level as a structural note (not a content-quality defect, just recorded for the importer's awareness).

Strand 4 'Agriculture and Climate' has THREE Sub-Strands in Year One (Climate Variability / Climate Change Adaptation / Climate Change Mitigation Strategies) but only ONE combined Sub-Strand in Years Two and Three, printed as Sub-Strand 1 'CLIMATE CHANGE VARIABILITY AND CHANGE' (Year 2) / 'CLIMATE VARIABILITY AND CHANGE' (Year 3) - again a genuine structural asymmetry across Years, preserved verbatim, flagged NEEDS_REVIEW as a structural note.

Teaching and Learning Resources are confirmed attached PER CONTENT STANDARD throughout the whole document (not once per Sub-Strand), consistent with the Phase-7 sample finding - every contentStandards[] entry below carries its own teachingLearningResources array.

Front matter (PDF pages 1-22): shared SHS boilerplate (Curriculum Overview, Philosophy/Vision/Goal/Rationale, 21st Century Skills, GESI, SEL, Learning and Teaching Approaches, UDL, Bloom's/Webb's DoK framework, Curriculum Development Panel list, Scope-and-Sequence summary table) - not re-extracted per-node per the schema's Phase 5 design notes. The Scope and Sequence summary table itself (PDF page 23-24, printed 'AGRICULTURAL SCIENCE | 21'-'22') extracts with severe column misalignment via pdftotext -layout (numeric columns run together, e.g. '33 11 11 26 11 12 26') exactly as previously flagged in the inventory pass; only the bottom-line SHS1-3 overall totals (Content Standards 36, Learning Outcomes 37, Learning Indicators 85) are reliably readable from that table and are used here as the target reconciliation total, not the per-sub-strand breakdown.
